```prolog
:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- set_prolog_flag(double_quotes, codes).

read_int(I) :-
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, Cs),
    Cs \== end_of_file,
    Cs \== "",
    number_codes(I, Cs).

read_all_ints(Ls) :-
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, Cs),
    ( Cs == end_of_file -> Ls = []
    ; Cs == "" -> read_all_ints(Ls)
    ; number_codes_list(Cs, Ls) ).

number_codes_list(Cs, Ls) :-
    parse_nums(Cs, Ls).

parse_nums([], []).
parse_nums([C|Cs], Ns) :-
    ( code_type(C, space) -> parse_nums(Cs, Ns)
    ; parse_num(Cs, C, Ns) ).

parse_num(Cs, C, [N|Ns]) :-
    digit(C), !,
    collect_digits(Cs, Ds, Rest),
    number_codes(N, [C|Ds]),
    parse_nums(Rest, Ns).
parse_num([_|Cs], Ns) :-
    parse_nums(Cs, Ns).

collect_digits([], [], []).
collect_digits([C|Cs], [C|Ds], Rest) :-
    code_type(C, digit), !,
    collect_digits(Cs, Ds, Rest).
collect_digits([C|Cs], [], [C|Cs]).

main :-
    read_int(N),
    read_int(M),
    read_all_ints(Edges),
    length(Adj0, N),
    maplist(=([]), Adj0),
    build_adj(Edges, Adj0, Adj),
    bfs_count(Adj, 1, N, Ans),
    write(Ans), nl.

build_adj([], Adj, Adj).
build_adj([U,V|Es], Adj0, Adj) :-
    nth1(U, Adj0, AU, RestU),
    nth1(U, Adj1, [V|AU], RestU),
    nth1(V, Adj1, AV, RestV),
    nth1(V, Adj2, [V2|AV], RestV),
    V2 = U,
    build_adj(Es, Adj2, Adj).

bfs_count(Adj, Start, N, Ans) :-
    length(Dist, N),
    maplist(=(-1), Dist),
    nb_setval(queue, [Start]),
    set_dist(Dist, Start, 0),
    loop(Adj, Dist, 0, Ans).

set_dist(Dist, I, D) :-
    nth1(I, Dist, _, Rest),
    nth1(I, Dist2, D, Rest),
    Dist = Dist2.

loop(Adj, Dist, Ans0, Ans) :-
    nb_getval(queue, Q),
    ( Q == [] -> Ans = Ans0
    ; Q = [C|QRest],
      nb_setval(queue, QRest),
      nth1(C, Dist, DC),
      process(Adj, Dist, C, DC, Ans0, Ans1),
      loop(Adj, Dist, Ans1, Ans)
    ).

process(_, _, _, _, Ans, Ans) :- false.
process(Adj, Dist, C, DC, Ans0, Ans) :-
    nth1(C, Adj, Neigh),
    foldl(handle(Dist, DC), Neigh, Ans0, Ans).

handle(Dist, DC, N, Ans0, Ans) :-
    nth1(N, Dist, -1), !,
    D is DC + 1,
    set_dist(Dist, N, D),
    ( D =< 2 -> Ans is Ans0 + 1 ; Ans = Ans0 ).
handle(_, _, _, _, Ans, Ans).
```

:- module(main, [main/0]).

read_line_ints(Ls) :-
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, Cs),
    ( Cs == end_of_file -> Ls = []
    ; Cs == "" -> Ls = []
    ; atom_codes(A, Cs),
        split_string(A, " \t\r", " \t\r", Parts),
        maplist(atom_number, Parts, Ls)
    ).

main :-
    read_line_ints([N]),
    read_line_ints([M]),
    read_edges(M, EdgeList),
    assertz(edge(0,0)),
    forall(between(1,2,_), true),
    retractall(edge(_,_)),
    forall(member([U,V], EdgeList),
           ( assertz(edge(U,V)), assertz(edge(V,U)) )),
    findall(X, ( edge(1,X), X \== 0 ), L1),
    findall(Y, ( edge(1,X), edge(X,Y), Y \== 1, \+ member(Y, L1) ), L2),
    length(L1, C1),
    length(L2, C2),
    Ans is C1 + C2,
    write(Ans), nl.

read_edges(0, []).
read_edges(M, [[U,V]|Es]) :-
    M > 0,
    read_line_ints([U,V]),
    M1 is M - 1,
    read_edges(M1, Es).
